title: Async scorer paths must carry the registered scorer version beside the serialized scorer
answers: assessment from a UI-triggered or online scorer run has no scorer version
registered scorer version missing from evaluation job results
scorerVersion metadata lost when scoring runs in background job
async evaluate or session scorer assessments lack provenance
body:
Symptom: assessments from a registered scorer run in the background (UI-triggered evaluation, online trace or session scoring) lack mlflow.assessment.scorerVersion, while the same scorer run inline records it.
Root cause: mlflow/genai/scorers/base.py:Scorer._scorer_version is a PrivateAttr, so it is not in model_dump() or the serialized JSON. mlflow/genai/evaluation/job.py:invoke_genai_evaluate_job and mlflow/genai/scorers/job.py:invoke_scorer_job rebuild scorers from that JSON alone.
Fix pattern: pass the registered version as its own field next to the serialized payload (scorer_versions list, scorer_version param, OnlineScorer.scorer_version). Resolve the canonical stored scorer server-side, then call Scorer._set_registration_metadata(..., scorer_version=...) before evaluation.
Constraints: scorer_versions must match serialized_scorers in length; a mismatch raises invalid_parameter_value and the run ends FAILED. A None version means the scorer is unregistered and is left untouched. Hydration on the sampler path is in mlflow/genai/scorers/online/sampler.py:OnlineSessionSampler, so new background entry points need the same restore.
Applies: any new job, queue or serialized hand-off that reconstructs a Scorer from JSON and then evaluates it.
applies: Background or serialized scorer execution paths in mlflow/genai/evaluation and mlflow/genai/scorers; inline harness execution already holds the version on the object.
says: Evaluation runs started from the web interface do not display the registered scorer version.
Assessments generated by online trace scoring are missing the version of the evaluator used.
Show the registered evaluator version on assessment records when evaluations run in the background.
Session scoring results in the dashboard lack version provenance for our registered scorers.
Track which version of a registered scorer produced each background evaluation assessment.
search: Registered scorer versions must be passed alongside serialized scorers and restored before evaluation in background or asynchronous execution paths. Because Scorer._scorer_version is a PrivateAttr omitted during serialization, invoke_genai_evaluate_job, invoke_scorer_job, and OnlineSessionSampler must restore it via Scorer._set_registration_metadata using scorer_versions, scorer_version, or OnlineScorer.scorer_version. A length mismatch between scorer_versions and serialized_scorers raises invalid_parameter_value and marks the run FAILED, while unregistered scorers with None versions are left untouched. This rule applies to any job, queue, or serialized hand-off in mlflow/genai/evaluation and mlflow/genai/scorers that reconstructs a Scorer from JSON, whereas inline harness execution already holds the version.
